## About

Hi, I'm Tufail Shah — a Graphic Designer & Marketer helping businesses stand out and grow through powerful design across multiple mediums.

## Services

- **Campaign Designs** — Run successful campaigns that promote business sales across different media platforms.
- **Social Media Posts** — Make your social media pages stand out with designs that generate sales and engagement.
- **Mockup Designs** — Quickly evaluate marketing decisions with clear, visual mockups and iterative designs.
- **Newsletters** — Email designs that stand out and drive clicks to promote your products effectively.
- **Packaging Design** — Packaging that talks about your product positively and captures attention on shelves.
- **Illustrations** — Custom illustrations that tell your story and connect with your audience.
